_about: Every tier and price on the site comes from this file. Nothing else in the repo carries a number.
display: 'held' prints 'Price to be confirmed' everywhere and writes no figure into the built HTML at all.
A {{9}} inside any text is a figure: '$9' when shown, 'an amount to be confirmed' when held. {{50%}} is a discount: '50% off' when shown.
display: 'show' prints the figures. Flip it only when Michael signs off (open item O1), then run python build/build.py.
active_model picks which tier model the Membership page renders. Both are kept here until Michael says which is final.
Figures below are Michael's own, from the SARA THREE Price Menu (Final 11 3), as summarised in the Nov 11 brief. Not yet confirmed as final.

release_rules: Annual members receive their tier's material up front. Monthly members receive it at a steady pace.

Explorer and Discoverer, monthly: each School releases one week at a time over twelve weeks, and the next School opens when the first is finished. The eBook unlocks with the second payment. One disease study a quarter.

Counselor, monthly: the first month unlocks everything Discoverer receives, the Foundation of the Institute Course and the first live session. Months two to eleven unlock one School a month with its related collections and Family studies. Month twelve unlocks the rest. Every month brings a live session and one disease study.
Unreleased items can be bought ahead at the member's own discount. A monthly member can switch to annual at any time by paying the balance, and everything unlocks.
Schools unlock in the order the Institute sets.
Unused free monthly or quarterly benefits do not carry over.
upgrade_rule: Everything you have already spent counts toward bundles, courses and tier upgrades. An upgrade starts its benefits immediately and the new rate bills on the next cycle.
